title: Dua for the Farewell of Ramadan

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ،
lines.english: O God, O He who desires no repayment!
O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوآءِ،
lines.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yukaafi-u a'b-dahoo a'laas-sawaaa-i
lines.english: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!
Your kindness is a new beginning, Your pardon gratuitous bounty,

lines.transliteration: wa u'qoobatuka a'd-l wa qaz''aaaw-uka kheearah
lines.english: Your punishment justice, Your decree a choice for the best!

lines.arabic: إنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَآءَكَ بِمَنٍّ،
lines.transliteration: in aa'-t'ay-ta lam tashub a't'aaa-aka biman
lines.english: If You bestow, You stain not Your bestowal with obligation,

lines.arabic: وَإنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيا
lines.english: and if You withhold, You withhold not in transgression.

lines.arabic: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَأَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ،
lines.transliteration: tash-kuru man shkaraka wa anta al-ham-tahoo shuk-rak
lines.english: You show gratitude to him who thanks You, while You have inspired him to thank You.

lines.arabic: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ،
lines.transliteration: wa tukaafi-u man h'amidaka wa anta a'l-lam-tahoo h'am-dak
lines.english: You reward him who praises You, while though You have taught him Your praise.

lines.arabic: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa tas-turu a'laa mal-law shi-ta faz''ah'-tah
lines.english: You cover him whom, if You willed, You would expose,

lines.arabic: وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ،
lines.transliteration: wa tajoodu a'laa mal-law shi-ta manaa'-tah
lines.english: and You are generous toward him from whom, if You willed, You would withhold.
Both are worthy of Your exposure and withholding,

lines.arabic: غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ،
lines.english: but You have founded Your acts upon gratuitous bounty,
channelled Your power into forbearance,
received him who disobeyed You with clemency,

lines.transliteration: wa am-hal-ta man qas'ada linaf-sihee biz'-z'ul-m
lines.english: and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.

lines.arabic: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأَنَاتِكَ إِلَى الْإِنَابَةِ ، وَ تَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إِلَى التَّوْبَةِ
lines.transliteration: tastanz'iruhum bi naatika ilaal-inaabah wtat-ruku mua'ajalatahum ilaat-taw-bah
lines.english: You await their turning back without haste and refrain from rushing them toward repentance,
so that the perisher among them may not perish because of You
and the wretched may not be wretched through Your favour,
but only after Your prolonged excusing him
and successive arguments against him,
as an act of generosity through Your pardon, O Generous,
and an act of kindliness through Your tenderness, O Clement!
It is You who have opened for Your servants a door
to Your pardon, which You have named 'repentance'.

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ دَلِيلًا مِنْ وَحْيِكَ
lines.english: You have placed upon that door a pointer from Your revelation,

lines.arabic: لِئَلاَّ يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ :
lines.transliteration: li-al-laa yaz''il-loo a'n-hoo faqul-ta tabaaraka as-muka:
lines.english: lest they stray from it: You have said (blessed is Your Name),

lines.arabic: )تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ
lines.english: "Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Your Lord
will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into
gardens beneath which rivers flow,
upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet

lines.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ
lines.transliteration: wal-lad'eena aaamanoo maa'hoo nooruhum yas-a'a bay-na ay-deehim wabiay-maanihim
lines.english: and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands,

lines.arabic: يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
lines.transliteration: yaqooloona rab-banaaa at-mim lanaa nooranaa wagh-fir lanaaa
lines.english: and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!
Surely You are powerful over everything" (66:8).

lines.arabic: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ
lines.transliteration: famaa u'd'-ru man agh-fala dukhoola d'alikal-manzili
lines.english: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house
after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee zit-ta fis-saw-mi a'laa naf-sika lii'baadika
lines.english: It is You who have raised the price against Yourself to the advantage of Your servants,
desiring their profit in their trade with You,

lines.transliteration: wa faw-zahum bil-wifaadati a'lay-ka waz-zeeaadati mink
lines.english: their triumph through reaching You, and their increase on account of You,
for You have said (blessed is Your Name and high are You exalted),
"Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it,

lines.arabic: وَمَن جَاء بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلاَ يُجْزَى إِلاَّ مِثْلَهَا(
lines.transliteration: waman jaaa-a bis-say-yi-ati falaa yuj-zaaa il-laa mith-lahaa)
lines.english: and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ): مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ
lines.transliteration: wa qul-t: (mathalul-lad'eena yunfiqoona am-waalahum fee sabeelil-laahee kamathali h'ab-batin
lines.english: You have said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn

lines.arabic: أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِّئَةُ حَبَّةٍ
lines.transliteration: ambatat sab-a' sanaabila fee kul-li sumbulatim-mia-atu h'ab-bati
lines.english: that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;
so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ): مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا
lines.english: You have said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan,
and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

lines.arabic: وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
lines.transliteration: wa maaa anzal-ta min naz'aaa-irihin-na fil-qur-aaani min taz''aae'efil-h'asanaat
lines.english: And You have sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيْبِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee dalal-tahum biqaw-lika min ghay-bika wa tar-gheebika
lines.english: It is You who have pointed them through Your speech from Your Unseen and Your encouragement

lines.arabic: الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ
lines.transliteration: lad'ee feehee h'az'-z'uhum a'laa maa law satar-tahoo a'n-hum
lines.english: in which lies their good fortune toward that which - had You covered it from them

lines.arabic: لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَعِـهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ
lines.transliteration: lam tud-rik-hooo ab-s'aaruhum- wa lam tai'heee as-maau'hum
lines.english: their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard,
and their imaginations would not have grasped,

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتَ):فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُواْ لِي وَلاَ تَكْفُرُونِ(
lines.transliteration: faqul-ta: (ud'-kurooneee ad'-kur-kum- wa ash-kuroo lee wa laa tak-furoon)
lines.english: for You have said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!
You have said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you,
but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);
And You have said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you,
surely those who wax too proud to worship Me
shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).

lines.transliteration: fasam-may-ta dua'aa-aka i'baadah wa tar-kahoo as-tik-baaraa
lines.english: Hence You have named supplicating You 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud',

lines.arabic: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ،
lines.transliteration: wa tawaa'-a't-ta a'laa tar-kihee dukhoola jahan-nama daakhireen
lines.english: and You have threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.
So they remember You for Your kindness, they thank You for Your bounty,
they supplicate You by Your command,
and they donate for You in order to seek Your increase;

lines.transliteration: wa feehaa kaanat najaatuhum min ghaz''abik
lines.english: in all this lies their deliverance from Your wrath
and their triumph through Your good pleasure.

lines.arabic: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
lines.english: Were any creature himself to direct another creature

lines.arabic: عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: a'laa mith-lil-lad'ee dalal-ta a'lay-hee i'baadaka minka
lines.english: to the like of that to which You Yourself have directed Your servants,
he would be described by beneficence,
qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.

lines.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ،
lines.transliteration: falakal-h'am-du maa wujida fee h'am-dika mad'-hab
lines.english: So to You belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise You

lines.arabic: وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ، وَ مَعْنًى يَنْصَرِفُ إِلَيْهِ.
lines.transliteration: wa maa baqee lil-h'am-di laf-z'un tuh'-madu bihee wa maa'-nana yans'arifu ilay-h
lines.english: and as long as there remains for praising words by which You may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إِلَى عِبَادِهِ بِالْإِحْسَانِ وَالْفَضْلِ،
lines.transliteration: yaa man tah'am-mada ilaa i'baadihee bil-ih'-saani wal-faz''-li
lines.english: O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty,
flooding them with kindness and graciousness!

lines.arabic: مَا أَفْشَى فِيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ،
lines.transliteration: maaa af-shaa feenaa nia'-mataka? wa as-bagha a'lay-naa min-nataka
lines.english: How much Your favour has been spread about among us, Your kindness lavished upon us,
and Your goodness singled out for us!
You have guided us to Your religion which You have chosen,
Your creed with which You are pleased,
and Your path which You have made smooth,

lines.arabic: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَالوُصُولَ إلَى كَـرَامَتِكَ.
lines.transliteration: wa bas'-s'ar-tanaaz-zul-fata laday-ka wal-wus'oola ilaa karaamatik
lines.english: and You have shown us proximity to You and arrival at Your generosity!

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَـايَـا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa anta jaa'l-ta min s'afaayaa til-kal-waz'aaa-ifi
lines.english: O God, You have appointed among the choicest of those duties
and the most special of those obligations

lines.arabic: شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ،
lines.english: the month of Ramadan, which You have singled out from other months,
chosen from among all periods and eras,
and preferred over all times of the year

lines.arabic: بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالنُّورِ،
lines.english: through the Qur'an and the Light which You sent down within it,
the faith which You multiplied by means of it,
the fasting which You obligated therein,
the standing in prayer which You encouraged at its time,
and the Night of Decree which You magnified therein,

lines.arabic: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر،
lines.english: the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الأُمَمِ
lines.english: Through it You have preferred us over the other communities
and through its excellence You have chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.
We fasted by Your command in its daylight,
we stood in prayer with Your help in its night,

lines.arabic: مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
lines.transliteration: mutaa'r-riz''eena bis'eeaamihee waqeeaamihee limaa a'r-raz''-tanaa lahoo mir-rah'-matik
lines.english: presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which You have held up before us,
and we found through it the means to Your reward.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الْمَليءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ إلَيْكَ،
lines.transliteration: wa antal-malee-u bimaa rughiba feeheee ilay-k
lines.english: And You are full of what is sought from You,
munificent with what is asked of Your bounty,
and near to him who strives for Your nearness.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مُقَامَ حَمْدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa qad aqaama feenaa had'aash-shah-ru maqaama h'am-d
lines.english: This month stood among us in a standing place of praise,
accompanied us with the companionship of one approved,
and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ،
lines.transliteration: thum-ma qad faaraqanaa i'nda tamaami waq-tihee wanqit'aai' mud-datihee wa wafaaa-i a'dadih
lines.english: Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.

lines.arabic: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا
lines.transliteration: fanah'-nu muwad-diu'whoo wadaaa' man- a'z-za firaaquhoo a'lay-naa
lines.english: So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us,

lines.transliteration: wa gham-manaa wa aw-h'ashanaa ans'iraafhoo a'n-naa
lines.english: whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness,
and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim,
an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.
We say: Peace be upon You,

lines.arabic: يَا شَهْرَ اللَّهِ الْأَكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيْدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
lines.transliteration: yaa shah-ral-laahil-ak-bar wa yaa e'eda aw-leeaaa-ih
lines.english: O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ مَصْحُوبٍ مِنَ الْأَوْقَاتِ،
lines.english: Peace be upon You, O most noble of accompanying times!

lines.arabic: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْرٍ فِي الْأَيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ.
lines.transliteration: wa yaa khay-ra shah-rin fil-ay-yaami was-saaa'at
lines.english: O best of months in days and hours!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الْآمَالُ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min shah-rin qarubat feehil-aaamaal
lines.english: Peace be upon You, month in which expectations come near
and good works are scattered about!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِينٍ جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُوداً،
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min qareen jal-la qad-ruhoo maw-joodaa
lines.english: Peace be upon You, comrade who is great in worth when found

lines.arabic: وَأَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ.
lines.transliteration: wa af-jaa' faq-duhoo maf-qoodaa wa mar-joo-win aaalama firaaquh
lines.english: and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيفٍ آنَسَ مُقْبِلًا فَسَرَّ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min aleef aaanasa muq-bilana fasar
lines.english: Peace be upon You, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy,
who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِرٍ رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka mim-mujaawirin raq-qat feehil-quloob wa qal-lat feehid'-d'unoob
lines.english: Peace be upon You, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِرٍ أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min naas'irin aa'ana a'laash-shay-t'aan
lines.english: Peace be upon You, helper who aided against Satan,
companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-k maaa ak-thara u'taqaaa-al-laahee feek
lines.english: Peace be upon You - How many became freedmen of God within You!

lines.arabic: وَمَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بكَ!.
lines.transliteration: wa maaa as-a'da mar-raa'a h'ur-mataka bik
lines.english: How happy those who observed the respect due to You!

lines.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ،
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka maa kaana am-h'aaka lild'-d'unoob
lines.english: Peace be upon You - How many the sins You erased!
How many the kinds of faults You covered over!

lines.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ،
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka maa kaana at'-walaka a'laal-muj-rimeen
lines.english: Peace be upon You - How drawn out were You for the sinners!
How awesome were You in the hearts of the faithful!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ لَا تُنَافِسُهُ الْأَيَّامُ.
lines.english: Peace be upon You, month with which no days compete!

lines.arabic: أالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ سَلَامٌ.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min shah-rin huwa min kul-li am-rin salaam
lines.english: Peace be upon You, month which is peace in all affairs!
Peace be upon You, You whose companionship is not disliked,
You whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

lines.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ،
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka kamaa wafat-ta a'lay-naa bil-barakaat
lines.english: Peace be upon You, just as You have entered upon us with blessings
and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!
Peace be upon You - You are not bid farewell in annoyance
nor is Your fasting left in weariness!

lines.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبِ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهِ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka min mat'-loobin qab-la waq-tih
lines.english: Peace be upon You, object of seeking before Your time,
object of sorrow before Your passing!

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوءٍ صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-k kam min sooo-in s'urifa bika a'n-naa
lines.english: Peace be upon You - How much evil was turned away from us through You!

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا.
lines.transliteration: a'n-naa wa kam min khay-rin ufeez''a bika a'lay-naa
lines.english: How much good flowed upon us because of You!
Peace be upon You and upon the Night of Decree

lines.arabic: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر.
lines.english: which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!

lines.arabic: أالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالْأَمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu a'lay-ka maa kaana ah'-ras'anaa bil-am-si a'lay-k
lines.english: Peace be upon You - How much we craved You yesterday!
How intensely we shall yearn for You tomorrow!

lines.arabic: أَلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ ،
lines.english: Peace be upon You and upon Your bounty which has now been made unlawful to us
and upon Your blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الَّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-naaa ah-lu had'aash-shah-ril-lad'ee shar-raf-tanaa bihee
lines.english: O God, we are the people of this month. Through it You have ennobled us

lines.arabic: وَوَفَّقْتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِينَ جَهِلَ الْأَشْقِيَاءُ وَقْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa waf-faq-tanaa biman-nika lahoo h'eena jahilal-ash-qeeaaa-u waq-tah
lines.english: and given us success because of Your kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.
Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

lines.arabic: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ،
lines.transliteration: wa anta walee-yu maaa aaathar-tanaa bihee mim-maa'-rifatihee
lines.english: You are the patron of the knowledge of it by which You have preferred us,
and its prescribed practices to which You have guided us.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ عَلى تَقْصِير،
lines.transliteration: wa qad t-tawal-lay-naa bitaw-feeqika s'eeaamahoo waqeeaamahoo a'laa taq-s'eer
lines.english: We have undertaken, through Your giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings,
and we have performed little of much.
O God, so to You belongs praise, in admission of evil doing

lines.arabic: وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالْإِضَاعَةِ، وَلَكَ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ،
lines.transliteration: waa'-tiraafam-bil-iz''aaa'h wa laka min quloobinaa a'q-dun-nadam
lines.english: and confession of negligence, and to You belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts
and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

lines.arabic: فَأْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ
lines.transliteration: fa'-jur-naa a'laa maaa ss'aabanaa feehee minat-taf-reet'i
lines.english: Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month,

lines.arabic: أَجْراً نَسْتَدْرِكُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ،
lines.english: with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it

lines.arabic: وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ ،
lines.transliteration: wa naa'-taaz''u bihee min anwaai'd'-d'ukh-ril-mah'-roos'i a'lay-h
lines.english: and win the varieties of its craved stores!

lines.arabic: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
lines.transliteration: wa aw-jib lanaa u'd'-raka a'laa maa qas'-s'ar-naa feehee min h'aq-qik
lines.english: Make incumbent upon us Your pardon for our falling short of Your right in this month

lines.arabic: وَابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ،
lines.transliteration: wa ab-lugh bi a'-maarinaa maa bay-na ay-deenaa min shah-ri ramaz''aanal-muq-bil
lines.english: and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!
Once You have made us reach it, help us perform
the worship of which You are worthy,

lines.arabic: وَأَدِّنَا إلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa ad-dinaaa ilaal-qeeaami bimaa yas-tah'iq-quhoo minat'-t'aaa'h
lines.english: cause us to undertake the obedience which You deserve,
and grant us righteous works

lines.arabic: مَا يَكُونُ دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ.
lines.transliteration: maa yakwnu darakal-lih'aq-qika feesh-shah-ray-ni min shuhoorid-dah-r
lines.english: that we may fulfil Your right in these two months of the months of time.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَمٍ أَوْ إِثْمٍ،
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maaa al-mam-naa bihee fee shah-rinaa had'aa mil-lamamin aw ith-m
lines.english: O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month,

lines.arabic: أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبِ وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَة
lines.transliteration: aw waaqaa'-naa feehee min d'ambin wak-tasab-naa feehee min khat'ee-ah
lines.english: the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned

lines.arabic: عَلَى تَعَمُّدٍ مِنَّا ، أَوْ عَلَى نِسْيَانٍ ظَلَمْنَا فِيهِ أَنْفُسَنَا ، أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا
lines.transliteration: a'laa taa'm-mudim-min-naaa aw a'laa nis-yaan z'alam-naa feeheee anfusanaa awi antahak-naa bihee h'ur-matam-min ghay-rinaa
lines.english: purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others,

lines.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ،
lines.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih was-tur-naa bisit-rik
lines.english: bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Your covering,
pardon us through Your pardoning,
place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنينَ،
lines.transliteration: wa laa tab-sut' a'lay-naa feeheee al-sunat'-t'aai'neen
lines.english: stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers,
and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate

lines.arabic: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ،
lines.transliteration: limaaa ankar-ta min-naa feeh biraa-fatikal-latee laa tanfad
lines.english: whatever You disapprove from us within it through Your clemency which does not run out,
and Your bounty which does not diminish!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
redress our being afflicted by our month,

lines.transliteration: wa baarik lanaa fee yaw-mi e'edinaa wafit'-rinaa
lines.english: bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking,

lines.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْوٍ، وَأَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبٍ،
lines.transliteration: waj-a'l-hoo min khay-ri yaw-mim-mar-ra a'lay-naaa aj-labihee lia'f-wiw-wa am-h'aahoo lid'amb
lines.english: make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Your pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,

lines.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لَنا ما خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ.
lines.transliteration: wagh-fir lanaa maa khafeea min d'unoobinaa wa maa a'lan
lines.english: and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْلَخْنَا بِاِنْسِلَاخٍ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma as-lakh-naa binsilaakhi had'aash-shah-ri min khat'aayaanaa
lines.english: O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses,
with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds,
and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people,

lines.arabic: وَأَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسَمَاً فِيـهِ وَأَوْفَـرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْـهُ.
lines.transliteration: wa aj-zalihim qis-man feeh wa aw-farihim h'az'-z'am-min-h
lines.english: the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!

lines.arabic: أللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى حَقَّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma waman- raa'a h'aq-qa had'aash-shah-ri h'aq-qa ria'ayatih
lines.english: O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed,

lines.arabic: وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا،
lines.transliteration: wa h'afiz'a h'ur-matahoo h'aq-qa h'if-z'ihaa wa qaama bih'udoodihee h'aq-qa qeeaamihaa
lines.english: safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to,

lines.arabic: وَأتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَة
lines.transliteration: wa at-taqaa d'unoobahoo h'aq-qa tuqaatihaa aw taqar-raba ilay-ka biqur-batin
lines.english: fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to You with any act of nearness-seeking

lines.arabic: أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ،
lines.transliteration: aw-jabat riz''aaka lah wa a't'afat rah'-mataka a'lay-h
lines.english: which makes incumbent upon him Your good pleasure and bends toward him Your mercy,
give to us the like [of that] from Your wealth
and bestow it upon us in multiples through Your bounty,

lines.arabic: فَإنَّ فَضْلَكَ، لا يَغِيْضُ وَإنَّ خَـزَائِنَكَ لا تَنْقُصُ، بَـلْ تَفِيضُ
lines.transliteration: fa in-na faz''-laka laa yagheez'' wa in-na khazaaa-inaka laa tanqus'u bal tafeez'
lines.english: for Your bounty does not diminish, Your treasuries do not decrease but overflow,

lines.transliteration: wa in-na maa'adina ih'-saanika laa taf-naa
lines.english: the mines of Your beneficence are not exhausted,
and Your bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

lines.arabic: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ اُجُوْرِ مَنْ صَامَهُ
lines.transliteration: wak-tub lanaa mith-la ujoori man s'aamahooo
lines.english: and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it

lines.arabic: أَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيْهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
lines.transliteration: aw taa'b-bada laka feeheee ilaa yaw-mil-qeeaamah
lines.english: or worshipped You within it until the Day of Resurrection!

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-naa natoobu ilay-ka fee yaw-mi fit'-rinaa
lines.english: O God, we repent to You in our day of fast-breaking,
which You have appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy

lines.arabic: وَلِاَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً مُحْتَشَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْب أَذْنَبْنَاهُ،
lines.transliteration: wa liah-li mil-latika maj-maa'w-wamuh'-tashadaa min kul-li d'ambin ad'-nab-naah
lines.english: and for the people of Your creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did,

lines.arabic: أَوْ سُوْءٍ أَسْلَفْنَاهُ، أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ،
lines.transliteration: aw sooo-in as-laf-naah aw khaat'iri shar-rin az''-mar-naah
lines.english: ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived,

lines.arabic: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوْعٍ إلَى ذَنْب
lines.transliteration: taw-bata mal-laa yant'awee a'laa rujooi'n ilaa d'amb
lines.english: the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin

lines.transliteration: wa laa yau'wdu baa'-dahaa fee khat'ee-ah
lines.english: and who afterwards will not go back to offense,

lines.arabic: تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالْاِرْتِيَابِ،
lines.english: an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.

lines.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَثَبِّتنَا عَلَيْهَا.
lines.transliteration: fataqab-bal-haa min-naa war-z''a a'n-naa wa thab-bit-naa a'lay-haa
lines.english: So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!
God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment

lines.arabic: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتّٰى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ،
lines.transliteration: wa shaw-qa thawaabil-maw-u'wd h'at-taa najid lad'-d'ata maa nad-u'wka bih
lines.english: and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate You
and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in You!

lines.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ،
lines.transliteration: waj-a'l-naa i'ndaka minat-taw-waabeenal-lad'eena aw-jab-ta lahum mah'ab-batak
lines.english: And place us with You among the repenters, those upon whom You have made Your love obligatory

lines.arabic: وَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ.
lines.transliteration: wa qabil-ta min-hum muraajaa'ta t'aaa'tik yaaa aa'-dalal-a'adileen
lines.english: and from whom You have accepted the return to obeying You! O Most Just of the just!

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبآئِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِيْنِنَا جَمِيعاً
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma tajaawaz a'n aaabaaa-inaa wa um-mahaatinaa wa ah-li deeninaa jameea'
lines.english: O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion,

lines.arabic: مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
lines.transliteration: man salafa min-hum waman ghabara ilaa yaw-mil-qeeaamah
lines.english: those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!

lines.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّنَا وَآلِهِ،
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madin-nabee-yinaa wa aaalihee
lines.english: O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household,
as You have blessed Your angels brought nigh,
bless him and his Household,
as You have blessed Your prophets sent out,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
lines.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'lay-hee wa aaalihee kamaa s'al-lay-ta a'laa i'baadikas'-s'aalih'een
lines.english: bless him and his Household, as You have blessed Your righteous servants

lines.arabic: وَأَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
lines.transliteration: wa af-z''al min d'alika yaa rab-bal-a'alameena
lines.english: and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!

lines.transliteration: s'alaatan tab-lughunaa barakatuhaa wa yanaalunaa naf-u'haa
lines.english: a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us,
and through which our supplication may be granted!
You are the most generous of those who are beseeched,
the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had,

lines.transliteration: wa aa'-t'aa man su-ila min faz''-lih
lines.english: the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked,

lines.transliteration: wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
lines.english: You are powerful over everything!
